extraction_supporting_text.p_value: Likewise, results from the time-varying analysis were similar, suggesting that lycopene was associated with a decreased risk of RCC (fourth quartile: HR, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.42–0.98; P trend = .05), and no other micronutrients were associated with risk.
extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: In the current analysis, we included all participants in the clinical trials and the observational study except for women who enrolled in the Dietary Modification clinical trial (n = 48,835) who had a history of any cancer other than nonmelanoma skin cancers at study entry 7 , 10 , 12 or who had implausible energy intakes (<600 or >5000 kcal daily) at baseline (n = 4067). This resulted in an inclusive total of 96,196 women in our analytic cohort.
extraction_supporting_text.timing: who enrolled in the Women’s Health Initiative (WHI) between 1993 and 1998 and were followed through July 2013 were included in this analysis.
